fonts.display: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Sodium Yellow
palette.role: Primary CTA fills, active nav indicators, accent card backgrounds, logo wordmark, and the single chromatic punctuation across an otherwise monochrome system

palette.name: Lime Pulse
palette.role: Editorial accent — one or two keyword words per page glow in this green to carry emphasis and keep the palette from feeling monochrome

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Page background canvas — the near-black with a barely-warm tint that anchors the entire system

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Elevated card surfaces, outlined button borders, and the primary border tone for sections that need separation from the canvas

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Secondary borders, divider lines, and inactive control outlines where a softer edge is needed

palette.name: Frost
palette.role: Primary body and UI text — the off-white that softens contrast against the carbon canvas and reduces eye strain across long reading passages

palette.name: Cloud
palette.role: Headline and display text on dark surfaces — a step brighter than Frost, reserved for the largest type that needs extra punch

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Text on yellow fills and inside bright accent cards; the only acceptable text color over Sodium Yellow

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Muted helper text, metadata, and secondary link colors where legibility matters less than hierarchy

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Deep accents within dark illustrations and subtle depth layers where pure black would feel too harsh
